cards.ex: The artist spent weeks trying to conceptualize ideas for his new sculpture.
cards.exUz: Rassom yangi haykali uchun g'oyalarni shakllantirishga haftalar sarfladi.
cards.uzDef: G'oyalarni aniq shaklga keltirish, rejalashtirish va tushunish.

cards.ex: Writing short stories is a good way to exercise imagination.
cards.exUz: Qisqa hikoyalar yozish tasavvurni mashq qildirishning yaxshi usuli.
cards.uzDef: Tasavvurni rivojlantirish uchun turli xil vazifalarni bajarish.

cards.ex: Starting a band is a creative endeavor that requires dedication.
cards.exUz: Guruh tuzish - bu sadoqat talab qiladigan ijodiy urinish.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy maqsadga erishish uchun qilingan harakat.

cards.ex: Art classes help children unleash potential they never knew they had.
cards.exUz: San'at darslari bolalarga o'zlarida borligini bilmagan imkoniyatlarni ochishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Yashirin qobiliyatlarni namoyon qilishga imkon berish.

cards.ex: Painting is a form of creative expression that allows people to communicate their emotions.
cards.exUz: Rasm chizish - bu odamlarga o'z hissiyotlarini ifoda etishga imkon beradigan ijodiy ifoda shakli.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini san'at orqali namoyon etish.

cards.ex: The mysterious story really stirred the imagination of the young readers.
cards.exUz: Sirli hikoya yosh kitobxonlarning tasavvurini haqiqatan ham qo'zg'atdi.
cards.uzDef: Tasavvurni faollashtirish, hayolga ilhom berish.

cards.ex: His mental landscape was filled with vibrant colors and fantastical creatures.
cards.exUz: Uning aqliy manzarasi yorqin ranglar va fantastik maxluqlar bilan to'lgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning ichki dunyosi, fikrlari va tasavvurlari majmui.

cards.ex: Her novel is full of flights of imagination that transport readers to another world.
cards.exUz: Uning romani o'quvchilarni boshqa dunyoga olib boradigan fantaziya parvozlari bilan to'la.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatdan uzoq, g'ayrioddiy xayolotlar.

cards.ex: Entrepreneurs often forge new paths in the business world.
cards.exUz: Tadbirkorlar ko'pincha biznes olamida yangi yo'llar yaratadilar.
cards.uzDef: Avval bo'lmagan yangi usullarni yoki yondashuvlarni ishlab chiqish.

cards.ex: Lateral thinking is crucial for solving complex puzzles.
cards.exUz: Yonlama fikrlash murakkab jumboqlarni hal qilish uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarni noodatiy, ijodiy usullar bilan hal qilish.

cards.ex: Philosophy deals with abstract concepts like truth and justice.
cards.exUz: Falsafa haqiqat va adolat kabi mavhum tushunchalar bilan shug'ullanadi.
cards.uzDef: Konkret bo'lmagan, sezgi bilan tushunish qiyin bo'lgan g'oyalar.

cards.ex: The director's artistic vision transformed the play into a masterpiece.
cards.exUz: Rejissyorning badiiy qarashi spektaklni shoh asarga aylantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Rassomning o'ziga xos dunyoqarashi va uni san'at orqali ifodalash usuli.

cards.ex: The workshop helped me tap into potential I didn't know I had.
cards.exUz: Seminar men bilmagan salohiyatni ishga solishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud imkoniyatlardan to'liq foydalanish.

cards.ex: Companies need an innovative mindset to stay competitive.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar raqobatbardosh bo'lish uchun innovatsion fikrlashga muhtoj.
cards.uzDef: Yangi g'oyalarni qabul qilish va yaratishga tayyorlik.

cards.ex: Her intellectual curiosity led her to explore many different fields of study.
cards.exUz: Uning intellektual qiziquvchanligi uni ko'plab turli xil o'quv sohalarini o'rganishga undadi.
cards.uzDef: Bilishga, yangi narsalarni o'rganishga bo'lgan kuchli istak.

cards.ex: The painting was praised for its artistic merit and originality.
cards.exUz: Rasm o'zining badiiy qimmati va o'ziga xosligi uchun maqtovga sazovor bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: San'at asarining badiiy qiymati, ahamiyati.

cards.ex: His research was considered groundbreaking work in the field of medicine.
cards.exUz: Uning tadqiqoti tibbiyot sohasida kashfiyot ishi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z sohasida yangi, muhim yutuq bo'lgan ish.

cards.ex: The company is known for its bold ideas and innovative products.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya o'zining jasur g'oyalari va innovatsion mahsulotlari bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Qo'rqmas, noodatiy va o'ziga ishongan g'oyalar.

cards.ex: We spent the afternoon dreaming up ideas for our next project.
cards.exUz: Biz tushdan keyin keyingi loyihamiz uchun g'oyalar o'ylab topishga vaqt sarfladik.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va qiziqarli g'oyalarni yaratish.

cards.ex: She has a strong artistic sensibility and a great eye for detail.
cards.exUz: U kuchli badiiy sezgirlikka va detallarga ajoyib e'tiborga ega.
cards.uzDef: San'atni tushunish va qadrlash qobiliyati.

cards.ex: The adventurous story fired the imagination of the young boy.
cards.exUz: Sarguzashtli hikoya yosh bolaning tasavvurini o't oldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Kuchsiz tasavvurni ilhomlantirish va jonlantirish.

cards.ex: Schools should foster creativity in students through art and music programs.
cards.exUz: Maktablar san'at va musiqa dasturlari orqali o'quvchilarda ijodni rag'batlantirishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy qobiliyatlarni rivojlantirishga yordam berish.

cards.ex: The scientist is always trying to push the limits of what is possible.
cards.exUz: Olim har doim mumkin bo'lgan narsalarning chegaralarini kengaytirishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: O'rnatilgan chegaralardan o'tib, yangi imkoniyatlarni kashf qilish.

cards.ex: The company developed an innovative solution to reduce waste.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya chiqindilarni kamaytirish uchun innovatsion yechim ishlab chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoga yangicha va samarali yondashuv.

cards.ex: Abstract thinking is essential for understanding complex theories.
cards.exUz: Mavhum fikrlash murakkab nazariyalarni tushunish uchun zarurdir.
cards.uzDef: Konkret misollar bermasdan, g'oyalar va tushunchalar haqida o'ylash.

cards.ex: To truly innovate, you have to think outside convention.
cards.exUz: Haqiqatan ham innovatsiya qilish uchun an'anadan tashqari fikrlashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagi usullardan voz kechib, yangi yondashuvlarni qidirish.

cards.ex: The film offers a unique artistic interpretation of the classic novel.
cards.exUz: Film klassik romaning o'ziga xos badiiy talqinini taqdim etadi.
cards.uzDef: San'at asarini o'ziga xos uslubda tushunish va ifodalash.

cards.ex: The conference spawned many new ideas and collaborations.
cards.exUz: Konferensiya ko'plab yangi g'oyalar va hamkorliklarni keltirib chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi g'oyalarning paydo bo'lishiga sabab bo'lish.

cards.ex: Travel can ignite creativity and broaden your horizons.
cards.exUz: Sayohat ijodni yoqishi va dunyoqarashingizni kengaytirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy jarayonni boshlash, ilhomlantirish.

cards.ex: The company strives to innovate relentlessly to stay ahead of the competition.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya raqobatda oldinda bo'lish uchun tinimsiz innovatsiya qilishga intiladi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda yangi g'oyalar yaratish va ularni amalda qo'llash.
